name: DMT
addictionPotential: Non-addictive with a low abuse potential
effectsSummary: DMT as a potent tryptamine psychedelic with overwhelming, rapidly developing effects; its effects index is based on anecdotal reports and adverse effects become more likely as dose increases.
dosageRemark: Ayahuasca is a shamanic herbal potion made from DMT-containing chacruna leaves (Psychotria viridis) and the harmaline-containing ayahuasca liana Banisteriopsis caapi. Harmaline is an MAO inhibitor. MAO inhibitors are substances and drugs that prevent the enzyme MAO from breaking down the body's own messenger substances such as adrenalin, dopamine, serotonin, etc. As well as foreign alkaloids such as caffeine, cocaine, etc. MAO normally also degrades the active substance DMT even before it can enter the central nervous system via the blood-brain barrier.\nChanga is a mixture for smoking of DMT-containing plants (but usually mostly crystalline DMT) and herbs that act as MAO inhibitors. Source archive smoked table: threshold 2 mg; light 10-20 mg, moderate 20-40 mg, strong 40-60 mg, heavy 60 mg+; total 5-20 min, onset 20-40 sec, comeup 1-3 min, peak 2-8 min, offset 1-6 min and afterglow 10-60 min. The table is educational user/resource material, not a recommendation. The existing intravenous route has no matching table in this archived page and is retained as previously sourced data, not attributed to this archive.
generalRisks: Effects may be unpredictable and adverse reactions increase with the dose. DMT is described as a potent psychedelic, and harm reduction is recommended.
longtermRisks: Permanent disturbances in self- and reality recognition are possible. The view of the world can be permanently called into question, which can make it difficult to cope with everyday life. Latent (hidden) psychoses can be triggered.
saferUse: Starting low is advised, because of differences in weight, tolerance, metabolism and individual sensitivity, and harm reduction and independent research are recommended.
summary: DMT is a short-acting, potent tryptamine psychedelic. FreeODwiki's smoked dose table is user/resource material for education and the page stresses individual variability and harm reduction.
